---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
```

```{r data}
data("rest_inspec")
inspection_data = rest_inspec %>%
  rename(borough = boro) %>%
  filter(
    grade %in% c("A", "B", "C"),
    !borough %in% c("Missing", "0"),
    !is.na(camis),
    !is.na(inspection_date)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    borough = str_to_title(borough),
    score = as.numeric(score)
  ) %>%
  distinct(camis, inspection_date, grade, score, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(score))
cuisine_summary = inspection_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(cuisine_description), cuisine_description != "") %>%
  group_by(cuisine_description) %>%
  summarize(
    n_inspections = n(),
    pct_grade_a = mean(grade == "A") * 100,
    median_score = median(score),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_inspections >= 100) %>%
  slice_max(n_inspections, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE)
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
### Inspection scores by borough

```{r score-boxplot}
inspection_data %>%
  mutate(borough = fct_reorder(borough, score, .fun = median)) %>%
  plot_ly(
    x = ~borough,
    y = ~score,
    color = ~borough,
    type = "box",
    boxpoints = FALSE,
    hovertemplate = paste(
      "Borough: %{x}<br>Score: %{y}<extra></extra>"
    )
  ) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Borough"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Inspection score"),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )
```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
### Inspection grade counts

```{r grade-bars}
inspection_data %>%
  count(borough, grade) %>%
  plot_ly(
    x = ~borough,
    y = ~n,
    color = ~grade,
    type = "bar",
    colors = c("A" = "#2E8B57", "B" = "#E6AB02", "C" = "#D95F02"),
    hovertemplate = paste(
      "Borough: %{x}<br>Grade: %{fullData.name}<br>Inspections: %{y}<extra></extra>"
    )
  ) %>%
  layout(
    barmode = "stack",
    xaxis = list(title = "Borough"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of inspections")
  )
```

### Cuisine: inspection volume and A-grade share

```{r cuisine-scatter}
cuisine_summary %>%
  plot_ly(
    x = ~n_inspections,
    y = ~pct_grade_a,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    color = ~median_score,
    size = ~n_inspections,
    text = ~cuisine_description,
    sizes = c(8, 28),
    marker = list(opacity = 0.75),
    hovertemplate = paste(
      "Cuisine: %{text}<br>Inspections: %{x}<br>",
      "Grade A: %{y:.1f}%<br>Median score: %{marker.color}<extra></extra>"
    )
  ) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Number of inspections (cuisines with at least 100)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Inspections receiving grade A (%)")
  )
```

### About these data
Each point or count in this dashboard represents an inspection record after removing duplicate violation rows. Inspection scores are lower for better results; grades A, B, and C are shown. The cuisine comparison includes the 15 most frequently inspected cuisine categories among categories with at least 100 inspections.
